title.narrative: (Pillar 3: 90%) Protection of the Most Vulnerable Migrant Workers and Migrant Children through a multi-sectoral approach, and (Pillar 2: 10%) Strengthening the Co-Coordination the Migrant Sector

description.narrative:
ltpgtThe overall objective of the proposed project is to address the urgent needs, including key protection needs, of vulnerable Migrant Workers in Lebanon in key geographies.ltbrgtlt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtThe project will target migrants through a set vulnerability list, reaching those who have been most affected by the economic situation, by a lack of legal documents in the country and by the long-standing challenges posed by the Kafala system/sponsorship system in Lebanon, resulting in heightened risk of exploitation, abuse, eviction and human trafficking. lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtThe proposed intervention focuses on addressing urgent protection needs of vulnerable Migrant Workers and Migrant Children in to reduce the risk of eviction, exploitation and trafficking through provision of emergency support through case management after outreach and screening, voluntary return, cash for rent, NFI and awareness raising, legal services, MHPSS and empowerment and enhanced coordination through migrant inclusion (via the translation hub and capacitating 4 migrant community groups) and Migrant sector Co-coordination
lt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="color: black font-family: Arial, sans-serif"gtFurthermore, in order to ensure this group meaningful inclusion, the proposed intervention includes the establishment of a translation hub.lt/spangtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtltspan style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif color: black"gtltbrgtlt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltspan style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif color: black"gtFurthermore, the project aims to enhance the protection environment for vulnerable migrants in Lebanon by enhancing coordination and accountability amongst key stakeholders and duty bearers though closer coordination and follow up. lt/spangt
ltbrgtlt/pgt
